review:
Train Heist Johnny Cash is a cluster slot set aboard a speeding train, with Johnny Cash leading a heist. Winning clusters explode and the reels reflow, and wins turn into highlighted reward cells that feed a mini Coin Respin round in the base game.

Coin multipliers can reach 500x, alongside Coin Boosters and Collect Coin symbols triggered by TNT. There are three free spins modes: Free Spins (8 spins), Super Free Spins (12 spins with highlighted cells that stay active) and Mega Free Spins, which can only be triggered naturally. Chance x5 raises the chance of reaching the bonus. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,000x maximum and a 97% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 300 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 300 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
